# The compiler-rt builtins that libSystem exports (the ones that code generated
# by Clang calls: 128-bit integer division, __atomic_* for objects that are not
# lock-free, __clear_cache, ...).  They are part of libSystem because it links
# libcompiler_rt (Libsystem/requiredlibs of the open source release).
#
# <symbol> <architectures>      all, x86_64 or arm64; the Mach-O name, with the underscore
#
# Source of the names: LLVM, compiler-rt/lib/builtins/apple_versioning.c (the
# same in LLVM 16 to 23).  The file lists the symbols that libSystem has since
# macOS 10.6 (NOT_HERE_BEFORE_10_6: "Symbols in libSystem.dylib in 10.6 and
# later, but are in libgcc_s.dylib in earlier versions") and 10.9
# (NOT_HERE_IN_10_8_AND_EARLIER: __atomic_*); every release of the SDK is
# macOS 11 or later.  Not taken over: the sections for PowerPC (#if __powerpc__)
# and for 32-bit ARM (#if __arm__ && __DYNAMIC__).
# 99 + 40 names remain; 132 are for x86_64 and 119 for arm64, because an
# architecture only gets a builtin that compiler-rt builds for it:
#  - the tf variants (__fixtfdi, __fixunstfdi, __floatditf, __floatunditf,
#    __powitf2, __divtc3, __multc3) are left out for both architectures.  They need
#    a 128-bit floating-point type (CRT_HAS_TF_MODE in lib/builtins/int_types.h:
#    long double with a 113-bit mantissa, or __float128).  long double is the
#    x87 type on x86_64 and double on arm64, and Clang has no __float128 for
#    these targets (Darwin-excludes/osx.txt also lists five tf builtins).
#  - the x87 variants (x86_80_BIT_SOURCES in lib/builtins/CMakeLists.txt: the
#    names with xf or xc3) are only built for x86_64.
#  - __enable_execute_stack is not built for arm64 on Darwin
#    (lib/builtins/CMakeLists.txt: "Don't build enable_execute_stack on arm64
#    darwin"; not yet in LLVM 21, in LLVM 23).
# docs/SOURCES.md has the details.

# Builtins of compiler-rt that libSystem has since macOS 10.6 (apple_versioning.c: NOT_HERE_BEFORE_10_6, "Symbols in
# libSystem.dylib in 10.6 and later"), without the sections for PowerPC and 32-bit ARM, without the tf variants.
